description: PulteGroup, Inc. is a Michigan corporation organized in 1956, though it dates its founding to 1950 when its founder, Bill Pulte, built its first home, and over its history it has delivered over 875,000 homes. It is one of the largest homebuilders in the United States, and its common shares are included in the S&P 500 Index and trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol PHM. While its subsidiaries engage primarily in the homebuilding business, it also has financial services businesses, which include mortgage banking, title and insurance agency operations, through Pulte Mortgage LLC and other subsidiaries.
